parent_evidence.antecedent_rain_amount: 72 h antecedent precipitation amount positively predicts strong 0->CallingIndex2/3 activation after adjusting for DaysSinceRain.
parent_evidence.current_light_rain: Survey-time categorical light rain does not explain strong activation.
parent_evidence.local_template: Strong chorus reactivation is strongly targeted to previously used species x SiteID combinations.

question: Is the remaining rain-associated strong-chorus activation better explained by instantaneous atmospheric desiccation stress at survey time or by accumulated antecedent rainfall?
sample: NAAMP matched pairs for which both runs have parseable start/end times, route-centroid coordinates, ERA5 72 h precipitation and ERA5 2 m temperature/dewpoint at the survey midpoint.

weather_source.precipitation: tp hourly accumulation, same extraction semantics as NAAMP_ANTECEDENT_RAIN_AMOUNT_V0_1
weather_source.temperature_and_dewpoint: Discover variables by stable GRIB shortName/long_name metadata before response fitting; require unambiguous 2 m temperature and 2 m dewpoint variables.
weather_source.spatial_link: nearest ERA5 0.25 degree grid cell to route centroid
weather_source.temporal_link: nearest exact hourly timestamp to local survey midpoint converted to UTC

derived_cues.vpd_kpa: saturation vapour pressure at T minus actual vapour pressure from dewpoint, using Magnus formula; nonnegative
derived_cues.rh_percent: 100 * actual vapour pressure / saturation vapour pressure, capped to [0,100] only for numerical epsilon deviations
derived_cues.vpd_relief_contrast: dry-run VPD minus wet-run VPD; positive means the wetter survey had lower desiccation demand
derived_cues.rh_gain_contrast: wet-run RH minus dry-run RH; positive means the wetter survey was more humid
derived_cues.rain72_amount_contrast: same z-scored log1p 72 h precipitation wet-minus-dry contrast as antecedent-rain-amount analysis

primary_model: strong_new_score ~ rain_contrast + rain72_amount_difference_z + vpd_relief_difference_z + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), route-clustered covariance.

primary_predictions.accumulated_hydric_support: rain72_amount_difference_z beta >0 with complete 95% CI >0 after VPD adjustment.
primary_predictions.accumulated_over_instantaneous: Accumulated hydric opportunity favored if rain72 remains CI-positive while VPD relief is not CI-positive.
primary_predictions.mixed_cue: Both CI-positive indicates independent contributions of accumulated rainfall and instantaneous atmospheric moisture.

secondary: Replace VPD relief with RH gain; same sign expectation but no separate mechanism gate.
Use new_ci3_count as a full-chorus endpoint.
Repeat primary model in same-observer + physically stable pairs.
Report correlation between rain72 amount contrast and VPD relief contrast.
minimum_gate: At least 3500 pairs and 500 routes; exact ERA5 variable identity audit must pass.
interpretation: VPD/RH are atmospheric moisture proxies, not direct frog hydration measurements.
Antecedent precipitation is not direct pond depth or hydroperiod.
Both weather exposures are observational and cannot establish causal mediation.
No RC11 submission modification is authorized from this exploratory test.
